description: SHA-pinned fixtures for code-graph edge-level accuracy measurement. Every fixture must be at the pinned SHA before measurement; the harness exits 2 on drift.

fixtures.notes: Python-first fixture. Baseline: CALLS F1=0.981, IMPORTS F1=1.000 (scope-aligned).

Rust fixture on real redacted monorepo. Subset picked for structural variance: tiny pure-logic (canstatd 88 LOC) -> small async (calibd 184 LOC) -> monolithic (adsbd 631 LOC) -> large async-heavy (apid 6649 LOC, 52 files) -> macro/trait-heavy largest (assetman 20022 LOC, 118 files). Read-only per feedback memory.

Self-hosting Go fixture on code-graph itself. Originally planned psm/auth-gateway but that module has sqlc-generated types that aren't checked in, so Go RTA fails type-checking. code-graph is a ~90% Go codebase that type-checks cleanly. Subset picked for variance: store (SQLite CRUD), cypher (parser+executor), pipeline (multi-pass orchestrator), tools (MCP handlers), cbm (CGO bridge).
